# Christina Volodina

> Web developer (Germany) who designs, builds, deploys and tracks websites end to end.
> Focus: Next.js, React, TypeScript, responsive (fluid) layout, motion (GSAP, WebGL), SEO and GEO, multilingual sites (DE, EN, UK, AR with RTL), accessibility.
> Works with AI tools (Claude Code, GPT) under project rules, with every step verified.

## About
- Languages spoken: German (B1), Ukrainian, Russian. English and Arabic copy is written with AI tools.
- Location: Pforzheim, Germany.
- Open to any format: on-site, hybrid or remote; employment, freelance or B2B.
